actions.reason: K4_C0004 has an interpretable proliferation/stromal phenotype, but independent membership is not positively supported. Its set-versus-rest alignment shows essentially no within-versus-between distinction: silhouettes are near zero or negative (ct -0.051, wsi -0.014, rna 0.0003) and within-set distances equal or exceed between-set distances in every modality (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:6e0bda1ea1). Its structural diagnostic screens at candidate_k=1 with the smallest leading eigengap (0.108) and its only feasible k=2 split has near-zero silhouette (0.00042), so no internal subdivision is supported (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:6e0bda1ea1). The candidate-specific confounder report shows no corrected-significant factor association, with only a nominal ct_phase signal (p=0.028, q=0.252) that does not survive correction (ER:d2497140466c:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:6e0bda1ea1); absence of a proven confounder does not establish independence. With membership representation unsupported and no warranted structural revision, independent retention is not justified.

K4_C0002 has a coherent up-regulated metabolic phenotype, but its independent membership is undermined by a material candidate-specific technical alternative. Its set-versus-rest alignment is only modest and modality-dependent (silhouettes 0.011-0.177, clearest in wxs) (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fc5a03698e), and its candidate-specific confounder report shows multiple corrected-significant associations: tissue_source_site (V 0.428, q=0.0018), ct_reconstruction_kernel (V 0.387, q=0.0018), ct_scanner_model (V 0.374, q=0.0075), ct_manufacturer (V 0.353, q=0.0018), and continuous ct_slice_thickness and ct_z_spacing (epsilon_squared 0.174 and 0.180, q=7.4e-05) (ER:d2497140466c:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:fc5a03698e). These measured acquisition and site factors remain a plausible candidate-specific alternative explanation for the current membership, and no covariate adjustment or causal control was performed. With membership independence not positively established and a material technical alternative unresolved, retention is not justified.

K4_C0003 has a coherent immune/inflammatory phenotype, but its independent membership is undermined by a material candidate-specific technical alternative. Its set-versus-rest alignment is only modest (silhouettes 0.035-0.098) (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:42fb02ccf5), and its candidate-specific confounder report shows corrected-significant associations with tissue_source_site (V 0.443, q=0.009) and the continuous acquisition factors ct_z_spacing (epsilon_squared 0.082, q=0.010) and ct_slice_thickness (epsilon_squared 0.053, q=0.034), with a nominal ct_phase signal (p=0.026, q=0.0585) (ER:d2497140466c:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:42fb02ccf5). These measured site and acquisition factors remain a plausible candidate-specific alternative explanation for the current membership, and no covariate adjustment or causal control was performed. With membership independence not positively established and a material technical alternative unresolved, retention is not justified.

K4_C0001 has a coherent down-regulated OXPHOS/immune phenotype, but independent membership is not positively supported. Its set-versus-rest alignment shows only weak distinction: silhouettes are small and positive (0.003-0.090) and within-versus-between distance gaps are marginal, with wsi slightly reversed (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e5313ac502). Its candidate-specific confounder report shows a nominal tissue_source_site association (V 0.266, p=0.026, q=0.117) and a near-threshold ct_manufacturer association (V 0.254, p=0.006, q=0.054) that do not survive correction (ER:d2497140466c:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:e5313ac502); these residual technical considerations do not establish independence, and absence of a proven confounder does not positively establish a boundary. With membership representation weak and no warranted structural revision, independent retention is not justified.
